CustomObject.description: SCRUM-468 Lend Devices: one record per lending period of a demonstration device. Created when a sales colleague lends a device to a customer; Loan_Return_Datum__c stays blank while the loan is open and is set when the device comes back. Because every period is its own record, the whole lending history of a device survives returns and write-offs (AC7). Internal-only: no Experience Cloud, no customer-facing sharing.
CustomObject.label: Loan Record
